an8.64:1.1: I have heard that on one occasion the Blessed One was staying near Gayā at Gayā Head.
an8.64:1.2: There he addressed the monks, “Monks!” “Yes, lord,” the monks responded to the Blessed One. The Blessed One said,
an8.64:1.3: “Monks, before my self-awakening, when I was still just an unawakened bodhisatta, I perceived light but did not see forms.
an8.64:2.2: ‘If I perceived light and saw forms,
an8.64:2.3: then this knowledge-&-vision of mine would be purer.’
an8.64:3.1: “So, at a later time—staying heedful, ardent, & resolute—I perceived light and saw forms,
an8.64:3.2: but I did not associate with those devas, didn’t converse with them, or engage them in discussion.
an8.64:4.2: ‘If I perceived light and saw forms; and associated with those devas, conversed with them, and engaged them in discussion,
an8.64:4.3: then this knowledge-&-vision of mine would be purer.
an8.64:5.1: “So, at a later time—staying heedful, ardent, & resolute—I perceived light and saw forms; and I also associated with those devas, conversed with them, and engaged them in discussion;
an8.64:5.2: but I did not know of those devas that
an8.64:5.3: ‘These devas are from this or that deva host.’
an8.64:6.2: ‘If I perceived light and saw forms; and associated with those devas, conversed with them, and engaged them in discussion; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:6.3: ‘These devas are from this or that deva host,’
an8.64:6.4: then this knowledge-&-vision of mine would be purer.
an8.64:7.1: “So, at a later time—staying heedful, ardent, & resolute—I perceived light and saw forms; and associated with those devas, conversed with them, and engaged them in discussion; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:7.2: ‘These devas are from this or that deva host’;
an8.64:7.3: but I did not know of those devas that
an8.64:7.4: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas fell away from here and reappeared there.’ The thought occurred to me, ‘If I perceived light and saw forms; and associated with those devas, conversed with them, and engaged them in discussion; and I also knew of those devas that ‘These devas are from this or that deva host’; and I also knew of those devas that ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas fell away from here and reappeared there,’ then this knowledge-&-vision of mine would be purer.’
an8.64:7.5: “… I also knew of those devas that,
an8.64:7.6: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas fell away from here and reappeared there,’
an8.64:7.7: but I did not know of those devas that
an8.64:7.8: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas are nourished on such food and experience such pleasure & pain.’ …
an8.64:7.9: “… I also knew of those devas that,
an8.64:7.10: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas are nourished on such food and experience such pleasure & pain,’
an8.64:7.11: but I did not know of those devas that
an8.64:7.12: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas have such a lifespan and are of such long standing.’ …
an8.64:7.13: “… I also knew of those devas that,
an8.64:7.14: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas have such a lifespan and are of such long standing,’
an8.64:7.15: but I did not know of those devas whether I had lived together with these devas or not.
an8.64:8.2: ‘If I perceived light and saw forms; and associated with those devas, conversed with them, and engaged them in discussion; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:8.3: ‘These devas are from this or that deva host’; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:8.4: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas fell away from here and reappeared there’; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:8.5: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas are nourished on such food and experience such pleasure & pain’; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:8.6: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas have such a lifespan and are of such long standing’; and I also knew of those devas whether I had previously lived together with them or not,
an8.64:8.7: then this knowledge-&-vision of mine would be purer.’
an8.64:9.1: “So, at a later time—staying heedful, ardent, & resolute—I perceived light and saw forms; and associated with those devas, conversed with them, and engaged them in discussion; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:9.2: ‘These devas are from this or that deva host’; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:9.3: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas fell away from here and reappeared there’; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:9.4: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas are nourished on such food and experience such pleasure & pain’; and I also knew of those devas that
an8.64:9.5: ‘As a result of this kamma, these devas have such a lifespan and are of such long standing’; and I also knew of those devas whether I had previously lived together with them or not.
an8.64:10.1: “And, monks, as long as this—my eight-round heightened deva-knowledge-&-vision—was not pure, I did not claim to have directly awakened to the right self-awakening unexcelled in the cosmos with its devas, Māras, & Brahmās, with its people with their contemplatives & brahmans, their royalty & commonfolk.
an8.64:10.2: But as soon as this—my eight-round heightened deva-knowledge-&-vision—was truly pure, then I did claim to have directly awakened to the right self-awakening unexcelled in the cosmos with its devas, Māras, & Brahmās, with its people with their contemplatives & brahmans, their royalty & commonfolk.
an8.64:10.4: ‘Unprovoked is my release. This is the last birth. There is now no further becoming.’”
